channel.title: Anime Manga Explosion
channel.desc: In this episode, we explore the craft of anime sound. Voice actor Otsuka Akio, who has performed in over 400 anime titles, recreates recording sessions from My Hero Academia and BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War, revealing the techniques behind iconic lines. We also go behind the scenes at the music recording session for the new anime Star Wars: Visions Volume 3 \"The Duel: Payback,\" where composer Inai Keiji crafts a dramatic score that brings the visuals to life.
